title: Black Widow night fighters redeployed to patrol around Roswell

tellings.quote: what I found out was that we had a night fighter during World War II called the Black Widow.

plain: In 1947, the US military is said to have moved Black Widow planes, a World War II night fighter, to patrol the skies around Roswell, New Mexico, the town where a craft is said to have crashed that year. The researcher John Brandenburg tells Michels this as something he dug up himself ("what I found out was that we had a night fighter during World War II called the Black Widow"), and he credits a work called Cosmic Awakening. If true, it would suggest the military was guarding the skies over Roswell as if it expected more visitors.
